SpeechRibbon third-party notices
================================

1. whisper.cpp 1.9.2
   Copyright (c) 2023-2026 The ggml authors
   License: MIT
   Source: https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/tree/v1.9.2

2. Whisper multilingual model small-q8_0
   Based on OpenAI Whisper model weights converted to ggml and quantized for whisper.cpp.
   License: MIT
   Source and model card: https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp
   Model SHA-256: 49C8FB02B65E6049D5FA6C04F81F53B867B5EC9540406812C643F177317F779F

3. Silero VAD 6.2.0 model for whisper.cpp
   Copyright (c) Silero Team
   License: MIT
   Source and model card: https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/whisper-vad/tree/main
   Model SHA-256: 2AA269B785EEB53A82983A20501DDF7C1D9C48E33AB63A41391AC6C9F7FB6987

4. FFmpeg 9.0.1
   Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
   License: GNU Lesser General Public License version 2.1 or later
   Source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.0.1.tar.xz
   SpeechRibbon uses FFmpeg as a separate child process. The bundled build has network,
   GPL, nonfree and all general-purpose encoders disabled. Its only enabled encoder is
   pcm_s16le, used solely to hand decoded samples to the speech recognizer as WAV.
   The exact configure line and source archive are present in third-party-sources.zip.

5. MinGW-w64 runtime
   Statically linked portions are covered by the notices included in
   COPYING.MinGW-w64-runtime.txt inside third-party-sources.zip.

6. Bergamot Translator 0.4.5 and Firefox Translations translation models
   Copyright Mozilla and contributors
   License: Mozilla Public License 2.0
   Sources: https://github.com/browsermt/bergamot-translator/tree/v0.4.5
            https://github.com/mozilla/firefox-translations-models/tree/main/models/tiny/enru
            https://github.com/mozilla/firefox-translations-models/tree/main/models/base-memory/jaen
   Bundled directions: English-to-Russian and Japanese-to-English. The models are
   stored and executed locally; no translation request leaves the computer.

7. Marian NMT
   Copyright (c) 2016 Marcin Junczys-Dowmunt and contributors
   License: MIT
   Source: bundled with the Bergamot Translator source tree.

8. SentencePiece
   Copyright 2018 Google Inc.
   License: Apache License 2.0
   Source: bundled with the Bergamot Translator source tree.

9. ssplit-cpp and PCRE2 10.39
   Licenses: Apache License 2.0 (ssplit-cpp) and BSD-style PCRE2 licence
   Sources: bundled with the Bergamot Translator source tree.

No network service, cloud model, telemetry SDK or updater is included.
